required_common_fields.id: stable opaque ID; no sequential guesswork used as authorisation
required_common_fields.workspace_id: required for customer-owned row and every protected join; global identity/platform exception explicit
required_common_fields.gym_id: required for location-owned operation; optional only for genuinely company-wide object
required_common_fields.version: optimistic concurrency token; expected version on consequential mutations
required_common_fields.effective_at: business effective instant, timezone policy captured where scheduled
required_common_fields.recorded_at: system ingestion/audit instant, never replaces late business time
required_common_fields.actor_reference: real human or scoped service principal; not a fabricated owner identity
required_common_fields.source_reference: allowlisted record type+ID+scope+version; actual relationship constraint verified
required_common_fields.operation_id: retry identity scoped to owning command and payload hash
required_common_fields.audience_or_field_bundle: explicit purpose/record/field projection; not public by default

special_types.money: exact recorded native currency/minor-unit precision; amount+currency+issuer, no binary-float business calculation
special_types.quantity: signed exact quantity with SKU/unit/location/source; not confused with money
special_types.time_interval: start/end instants with applicable schedule timezone and interval semantics; overlap/clipping rules explicit
special_types.versioned_snapshot: immutable issued/accepted source terms/data/brand hash and reference
special_types.protected_file: private storage handle/hash/media/scan state and explicit contextual access links, never permanent public signed URL in a record
special_types.identity_reference: provider subject/verified linkage only; factor/password secrets remain with supported identity provider

requiredness: Drafts may omit conditional fields; each transition validates required current fields before committing. Missing tenant values produce setup-required, not silent placeholder default.
